Review Title: Horrible account security and even worse customer support
Review Text:
Uber locked changes to my account over an unexplained $50 USD charge. I repeatedly told them I believed it was related to a fraudulent gift card transaction I had reported in April, which my bank fortunately blocked.

Instead, Uber Support repeatedly claimed the $50 was for a trip on a day I didn't use Uber, in USD even though we're in Canada and I haven't been to the US in two years. There was also no record of this supposed trip in my Uber history.

I asked 7 times for basic details about the transaction. Instead of answers, I kept receiving generic responses telling me they were happy to help and that I simply needed to pay the $50 to unlock my account.

They suggested someone had obtained my login credentials, despite my account already having a complex, randomly generated, unique password and 2FA.

Then Uber contacted me again and finally confirmed what I had been telling them all along: the $50 was the fraudulent gift card purchase from April that I had already reported. It was never a trip.

The fraud itself is concerning. The fact that my bank protected me when Uber didn't is worse. But spending hours dealing with support agents who repeatedly gave me incorrect information and asked me to pay a fraudulent charge was what really destroyed my confidence in Uber.

Review Title: Charged twice for one ride – Uber refused to investigate
Review Text:

Making a serious allegation of fraud without providing any facts or allowing a meaningful review is unacceptable. If this is Uber's standard of customer support and account investigations, it raises serious concerns about fairness and transparency!

By the way, in my experience, Uber consistently paid me around 3–5% less than the fare shown when I accepted each trip.

If you're a driver looking for a platform that values fairness and provides real customer support, choose Bolt instead. Based on my experience, I cannot recommend Uber.

Review Title: Here's a clearer and more professional…
Review Text:
On July 29, I used a 40% discounted Uber ride promotion. Before confirming the ride, I checked the fare, which was $20.50 before the discount. Based on the advertised 40% discount, I expected to be charged significantly less. However, after confirming the ride, I was charged $19.35.

When I contacted Uber Support, I was told that the 40% discount only applied to specific vehicle types, specifically item delivery rides, and not to standard passenger rides. However, the promotion did not state this anywhere. The discount was clearly labelled as applying to a ride, with no mention of any vehicle type restrictions or exclusions.

I explained that the restriction they referred to was not disclosed in the promotion, but instead of addressing my concern, the support agent ended the conversation and closed it, preventing me from discussing the issue any further.

I believe the promotion was misleading because the eligibility restrictions were not clearly communicated before I booked the ride. I would appreciate a proper explanation and a review of the fare charged.
